name: hinmil
description: Hindley-Milner type checking for plain JavaScript: type signatures in comments, no build step

hinmil.enable.markdownDescription: Run the HinMil language server. Set to `false` in a workspace's `.vscode/settings.json` to disable HinMil for that project only. A project can also opt itself out with `"enable": false` in its `hinmil.config.json` or `package.json#hinmil`.

hinmil.requiresConfig.markdownDescription: Only start the language server when a workspace folder contains explicit hinmil project configuration: an `hinmil.config.json` / `hinmil.config.js` file or an `"hinmil"` key in `package.json`. Useful as a user-level setting so HinMil stays dormant in unrelated projects.

hinmil.files.extensions.markdownDescription: Extensions checked by HinMil. Custom extensions should also be mapped to `javascript` through VS Code `files.associations`.

hinmil.files.include.description: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace root, included for standalone diagnostics.

hinmil.files.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from standalone diagnostics. Excluded modules can still be inferred as dependencies.

hinmil.diagnostics.enabled.description: Master switch: enable or disable all HinMil diagnostics.

enumDescriptions: Report type errors as hints (faded text).
Report type errors as informational messages.
hinmil.diagnostics.typeErrors.description: Type mismatch and unification errors: annotation-vs-implementation mismatches, non-callable calls, infinite types.

hinmil.diagnostics.unknownPropertyAccess.description: Accessing a property that does not exist on a known type (e.g. this.foemp on a class that only declares name and floors).

hinmil.diagnostics.missingRecordFields.description: Returning a record that is missing fields required by the annotated return type (e.g. returning {name} when Person requires {name, age}).

enumDescriptions: Don't report unknown fields on object literals.
hinmil.diagnostics.excessRecordFields.description: An object literal argument with a field its named record type (an alias such as `RangeParams`) does not declare (a typo such as `form` for an optional `from`).

hinmil.diagnostics.annotationNarrowing.description: Reserved: level for code 2009, which no check emits at the moment. An annotation narrower than the inferred union is reported as a type error (1003), or allowed for a lookup that can miss (see the README). Kept so existing configurations stay valid.

enumDescriptions: Don't report functions/methods without an HM annotation.
hinmil.diagnostics.missingSignatures.description: Functions and methods that have no HM type annotation.

enumDescriptions: Don't report variables without an HM annotation.
hinmil.diagnostics.missingVariableSignat.description: Non-function variable declarations that have no HM type annotation.

enumDescriptions: Trust user-written signatures: suppress annotation-vs-inferred mismatch diagnostics.
Also suppress diagnostics inside the body of any binding that carries a '::' annotation.
Also suppress diagnostics inside the body of every binding (annotated or not). 'missingSignatures' still nudges unsigned bindings.
hinmil.diagnostics.trustAnnotations.description: How aggressively to trust user-written '::' annotations. Each level is a superset of the previous.

hinmil.diagnostics.debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before publishing diagnostics after a document change. Only affects diagnostics — hover, completion and signature help respond immediately regardless of this value.

enumDescriptions: Use readable names (a, b, c) for type variables.
Use internal type variable names (t0, t1, ...).
hinmil.display.typeVariables.description: Style for displaying type variables in hover tooltips, completions and code actions.

hinmil.completion.enabled.description: Enable auto-completions for methods and record fields.

hinmil.completion.autoImports.description: Suggest not-yet-imported workspace exports (with an auto-added import statement) in identifier completions. Disabling this also stops the background workspace-export scan.

hinmil.signatureHelp.enabled.description: Show parameter type information when calling functions.

enumDescriptions: hinmil answers go to definition for imports and local names when VS Code's built-in TypeScript/JavaScript extension is not active (it already does this when it is).
hinmil always answers too (you may see a result from both).
Only type and annotation navigation (imports and local names are left to other extensions).
hinmil.navigation.definitions.markdownDescription: Go to definition for code: module paths, imported names (ESM, CommonJS, dynamic `import`), re-exports up to the real declaration, and local names.

hinmil.dom.globalTypes.description: Give browser globals (document, window, navigator, localStorage, sessionStorage) real nominal types with IntelliSense on a compact DOM catalogue, and make Document/Element/Window/Storage/Event/Navigator usable in ':: ' annotations. Members outside the catalogue silently resolve to Any. Disable if your project defines its own types with these names.

hinmil.dom.strictNulls.description: DOM lookups that can miss (getElementById, querySelector, getAttribute, Storage getItem, ...) return 'T | Null' instead of plain 'T'.

hinmil.syntaxHighlighting.enabled.description: Enable or disable syntax highlighting for HM type annotations in JS comments. Changing this requires a window reload.

hinmil.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the HinMil language server.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "This is the VS Code extension. Publish the CLI with: npm run publish:cli" && exit 1
